apps.name: Beaver
apps.subtitle: AI-powered voice notes
apps.localizedDescription: A note-taking app with AI-powered transcription, summarization, and iCloud sync.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Recording now opens the note immediately, live on the Transcript tab, instead of a separate live view
- Live transcription in short segments cut at pauses in speech, not mid-word
- Live summary updates roughly every 30s during recording; note auto-renames when you stop
- Recording is now blocked with a prompt to Settings if no API key is configured
- If transcription fails mid-recording, audio is still saved instead of lost

- Fixed AI-generated titles sometimes not being picked up due to formatting variance
- Fixed a broken v1.0.3 build so Keep Screen Awake actually ships
- Keep Screen Awake setting — prevents device auto-lock while the app is open

- Tap a note to open its detail view (Summary/Transcript tabs)
- Tap any transcript word or summary point to seek playback there
- Word/point highlighting synced to playback
- Fixed a navigation bug where tapping a note sometimes did nothing
- Fixed Keychain writes silently failing on ad-hoc/self-signed builds
